requirements_note: Matrix values/duration/repetitions are engineering choices calibrated against completed T04-T07 evidence; they are not numerical requirements from the source documents.

run_order.policy: sequential; one worker, one Compose project at a time; no concurrent cells
run_order.block_order: repeat the same deterministic SHA-256 cell permutation for normal/burst/mixed/scaling, then run the outage pair block; three repetition blocks
run_order.replacement_limit: At most two replacement attempts per non-outage cell total; outage replacements rerun the matched healthy/outage pair, at most two paired replacements per policy across the study. Preserve failed attempts; accepted repetitions remain exactly three.

budget.host: single Linux/WSL2 Docker host; 12 logical CPUs, 7.436 GiB Docker-reported memory; no service cgroup limits; no concurrent unrelated workload
budget.conservative_stack_starts: 138 planned run slots plus at most 92 replacement-run slots (84 non-outage replacements and 8 outage replacement phases); Docker build/start/teardown time is additional and bounded by runner timeouts; stop if clock/host gate fails.

runtime.container_resource_limits: none declared in Compose; single-run sequential execution is required
runtime.image_revalidation: Before each run, store docker compose images --format json and docker image inspect output. Require configured base tag and inspected ID/digest to match the pinned base image. Stage 1 captured inspect Config.Env REDIS_VERSION=7.4.2, matching the configured tag; it did not capture a live INFO server response, so report the immutable image identity and inspect build metadata without claiming a separately observed server-reported version. Rebuilt project images may have new IDs; report-study fingerprint must match within a cell.

recovery.threshold_origin: T07 healthy calibration, 1.5× each policy matched healthy legitimate-success p95, locked before T09. Do not recalculate or tune.
recovery.runner_behavior: scripts/redis-outage.sh dynamically computes 1.5× from each formal healthy run and applies it to its outage analysis. Preserve those dynamic analysis.json/analysis.md/analyzer.log and per-policy recovery-p95-threshold-ms.txt. For the locked result, copy the dynamic artifacts to *.dynamic-t07.*, then rerun scripts/analyze.py on each outage case with the frozen policy threshold and fixed window/sample/consecutive flags; the resulting analysis.json/analysis.md are the fixed-threshold report-study inputs. Keep the dynamic threshold file untouched.

network_metrics.sampler: research-pilot starts scripts/lab-common.sh lab_sample before the offered load; T08 validated TERM completion and matched API traffic. Do not sample during Redis pause/outage.
network_metrics.interval: first to last valid Redis INFO stats sample timestamps; report the observed interval in seconds with rates
network_metrics.semantics: cumulative Redis TCP counter deltas in bytes and bytes/second; total Redis traffic including workload, sampler INFO cpu/memory/stats, healthchecks and admin boundary commands; not pure limiter bytes/request and not wire/packet overhead
network_metrics.cadence_limit: T08 observed five samples at 2.29–2.42 s intervals despite one-second sleep because three sequential Compose exec calls dominate.
network_metrics.missing: incomplete and null when any sample lacks the counter
network_metrics.decrease: inconclusive and null if observed counter decreases; reset between samples can remain hidden
network_metrics.overhead: T08 paired 20-RPS traffic: output 844 B/s off vs 2059 B/s on, one pair only; contamination observed, no correction factor or latency conclusion.

atomicity_rq4.evidence: Use completed T06 real-Redis concurrent/shared and near-empty Fixed Window/Token Bucket invariant tests and forced non-atomic barrier control.
atomicity_rq4.claim_boundary: Recorded invariants/control only; not HTTP behavior/performance, natural race frequency, or a new formal T09 cell.

report_study_adapter.conversion: After actual outputs exist, create a separate result manifest containing clock_tolerance_ms, cells mapped to {id, expected_repetitions}, and runs mapped to {group, cell, repetition, path}; copy each planned result_path unchanged because it is relative to docs/experiments/protocol-v1/results/manifest.json and points into ignored root artifacts/protocol-v1. Do not pass this planned manifest to report-study.py before results exist and do not edit this plan into a result manifest. Preserve replacement attempts separately; list only three accepted valid attempts per cell in the result manifest and record all excluded attempts in the report.

acceptance.normal_mixed_scaling: Use the lock in protocol.md: exact source/config/image fingerprint, phase/class rate fidelity within ±5%, zero drops, scheduled=trace count, sent+dropped reconciliation, schedule lag p95 ≤ min(10 ms, 1000/target class RPS), wall/monotonic residual ≤5 ms, trace/counter/backend reconciliation, complete analysis, correct topology/policy and fresh state; healthy Redis limiter errors must be zero. Intended mixed/backend overload and expected outage fallback are outcomes, not tooling errors.
acceptance.burst: Evaluate separate legitimate/abusive classes in [0,2), [2,4), [4,30) seconds; each class/phase must meet ±5% where target >0 and lag p95 bound using that phase rate.
acceptance.outage: Existing runner healthy gate must pass before its corresponding pause: all legitimate successes, zero drops, transport errors, limiter errors, API limiter errors, and backend overload; afterward apply the same full per-class/phase/counter/clock checks, and record all four pause/unpause UTC transitions.
acceptance.outcome: Oracle result is separate from validity; preserve FW inconclusive and observed violations. Do not change thresholds after viewing data.
